swearing in schools can be understood as an institutional morality in dispute, and that the practice of swearing and teachers’ responses to it in schools can be conceptualized as a form of moral boundary work.
swearing in class, and its management by teachers, can be understood as moral work in a purified space.
swearing in classrooms is a moral problem that can be variably construed and that classroom settings can demand standards that are higher than in broader society.

the moral work that teachers do in the classroom, in the context of broader societal trends.
the moral work that swearing in class can perform.
how swearing in class can be understood as a moral problem in schools.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

swearing in class is a problem that needs to be solved by teachers, and students need to be educated about what swearing means in a school environment, and what the consequences are of using bad language.
swearing in schools is not a problem. It is the regulation of swearing in schools that is the problem.
swearing in class is not a moral issue, and should be dealt with as an issue of classroom management, not morality.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
swearing in schools is a moral problem, but that it is not a problem of swearing per se, but of the moral boundaries of school settings.
swearing in class is an institutional morality in dispute, where the moral work of schools is to inculcate standards that are more stringent than the broader society.
swearing in class is not simply a linguistic issue, but a moral issue that can be understood through the lens of purity, hygiene and taboo.
The main takeaway from our work is that
schools can be sites where students are expected to be more morally upright than the rest of society.

teachers’ responses to swearing in the classroom, and students’ responses to these responses, are not simply about the use of bad language. Rather, they are part of a moral project in which students are being socialised into particular ways
